rationale: Author-of-record lens. Verified against code: the ADR strike annotations match the spec's quoted :107/:108 rows by content and the diff is a single hunk at lines 104-116, so bead-3's OQ-2 draft-discovery amendment (ADR-0023.md:204) is untouched; carry-forward item 1 (blocked-child legacy shape) is named in §Legacy shapes and matches semantics_v2.go's G2 strictness (blocked is neither closed nor in_progress, no self-heal) with the real repair --force-backward flag (repair.go:93); item 3 (preserve-invalid-stored) is named as a distinct shape and is truthful — IsBackwardMove treats an invalid stored value as incomparable-therefore-backward (order.go:43-45), so plan.go step 4b's no-op genuinely preserves it; item 2's substance (advancePhaseOnClaim as an evidence-fresh writer whose implement-over-review write is legitimate, alongside the review-stored reasoning) is delivered in §Writer taxonomy and matches next.go:542-583's actual closure. go build and the agreement-table tests are green; worktree left clean. The REQUEST_CHANGES is carry-forward item 4: the sanction-sentence truth check is asserted but not actually performed against the strongest documented threat to the sentence. Bead 2's accepted residual in completeSyncPhase's own doc comment (internal/complete/complete.go:1398-1420) explicitly routes a choice to beads 4/5: either fold completeSyncPhase through a stored-aware no-op-on-backward guard, or 'extend the agreement-table wording to name this fence's honest scope' — because completeSyncPhase writes advanceState's freshly-derived nextMode unconditionally under the lock and, in the documented reachable residue state (stored=implement after a surfaced release-sync failure or claim/advance crash window, all lifecycle children open), lands plan over implement: a semantically identical backward-converging write not routed through the fenced SanctionedDerivedSync surface. Bead 4 delivered the taxonomy's universal sentence ('Every mindspec_phase writer ... exactly one sanctioned backward writer', guide lines 94-98/106-112) WITHOUT naming completeSyncPhase, and plan.md contains no bead-5/6 step folding the guard, so neither routed option was taken; the commit trailer says 'Deviations: none'. As shipped, the guide's central truth-claim is only lexically true, in a document whose entire purpose is state honesty — and the guide's own forward-by-evidence definition ('never a value older than what it just observed') would equally admit SanctionedDerivedSync, so without the completeSyncPhase caveat the three-way taxonomy cannot actually draw the line it claims. Doc-only fix, small.
